newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends down 25 cents after late recovery.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends down 25 cents after late recovery.

text.p: IPE October gas oil futures ended down just 25 cents a tonne after clambering higher just before the close.

Before that the market had slipped steadily lower over the day from a firm opening. October last traded at $247.00, while November ended 50 cents down at $240.25 ahead of American Petroleum Institute (API) stock figures to be released later on Tuesday.
"We made the downside objective of $244.50 (on October) and then rallied just ahead of the close due to the API stats," said Alistair Harris of brokers MeesPierson in London.
Heating oil sales from the United States to Europe may moderate any stock build this week due to high refinery runs, dealers said
They expect distillate stocks to be unchanged to 500,000 barrels higher in the weekly API report.
But despite the prospect of heating oil imports from the U.S., European diesel prices remain firm. In Rotterdam the premium for diesel above the IPE rose $3.00 a tonne to $23.50 on Tuesday.
IPE Brent remained weak during the gas oil close although above the day's lows.
November was down 23 cents a barrel at $24.26 at 1635 GMT, midway between support at $23.90 to $24.00 and resistance at $24.50, Monday's high.
